spans.s:
mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
One who blows a fire or a trumpet.
m. (-मः)
1 A name of the moon.
2 KṚṢṆ

BRAHMA, or the Supreme Spirit.
E.
ध्मा to blow, affix श.

m. (-कः)
A blacksmith.
E.
ध्मा to blow, (the forge,) कुन् Uṇādi aff.

ind.
Blowing reiteratedly, or the sort of sound made by blowing with a bellows or a trumpet.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 One who blows a bellows, a trumpet, &c.
2 Cruel.
m. (-नः)
1 A reed, (Arundo tibialis or karka.)
2 Blowing, (a wind instrument.)
f. (-निः or -नी)
1 Any tubular vessel of the body, as a vein, a nerve, &c.
2 The neck.
3

A sort of perfume; also हट्टविलासिनी.
E.
धम from ध्मा, to blow, &c. affix युच्, fem. affix इन् or ङीष् or ध्मा as before, Uṇādi affix अनि, and ङीप् optionally added.

m. (-लः)
The breast ornamented with gold or jewels: see धम्मिल्ल.

m. (-ल्लः)
Braided and ornamented hair, tied round the head, and intermixed with flowers, pearls, &c.
E.
धम a Sautra root, to breathe, affix विच्, धम्; मिल to meet, लच् affix, and the two conjoined.

n. (-म)
1 The body.
2 A house, a dwelling.
3 Dignity, consequence, eminence.
4 Spirit, pride, especially martial pride, heroism.
5 Light, splendour, radiance.
6 A ray of light.
7 A place, a spot^1, a country.
8 Birth.
E.
धा to contain, (life, a tenant, &c.) and मनिन् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-धिः)
The sun.
E.
धाम light, निधि a nest or receptacle.

f. (-नी)
Any tubular vessel of the body: see धमनी.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Splendid, luminous.
2 Eminent, exalted, illustrious.
3 Heroic.
E.
धामन्, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-वः)
1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.)
2 A plant, a sort of Ghosha, with white flowers.
E.
धामन् a dwelling, मार्ग a road, ब to go or approach, affix क, deriv. irr.
